heading: Pricing
currentAdvance: You're on the {plan} plan — unlimited products and 3D models, one model per product.
currentLimits: You're on the {plan} plan: up to {products} products and {models} 3D models, one model per product.
currentLimitsFree: You're on the {plan} plan: up to {products} products and {models} 3D models, one model per product. Upgrade to lift the limit.
keepAccess: You keep access until the end of the current billing period.
downgradeOverLimit: Anything over the new limit stays in your library, but stops rendering on your storefront until you remove enough to fit or move back up.
cancelBody: Your store drops to the {plan} plan at the end of the current billing period. Models and products over the free limit stay in your library but stop rendering on your storefront.
launchOfferDescription_one: {percent} off your first month on any paid plan. Applied automatically, with no code needed, when you subscribe before {date}.
launchOfferDescription_other: {percent} off your first {count} months on any paid plan. Applied automatically, with no code needed, when you subscribe before {date}.
includedBody: Plans differ only in how many products and models you can publish — nothing below is locked behind a tier, not even on Free.
featureModelsBody: Upload up to {size} MB per file, served from Shopify's CDN.
featureArBody: Quick Look on iOS, Scene Viewer on Android, WebXR in the browser — no app to install.
featureBlocksBody: Drop a viewer onto product templates or any page, plus an iframe snippet for everywhere else.
featureControlBody: Camera angle, field of view, zoom, auto-rotate, drag and scroll behaviour, control bar buttons.
featureLightingBody: HDR skybox and environment maps, exposure, tone mapping and contact shadows.
featureAnimationBody: Play embedded clips with a switcher and loop, play-once or off repeat modes.
featureVariantsBody: Show a specific glTF material variant, so one file can cover a colourway.
featurePreviewBody: Every setting renders in the same viewer your customers see before you save.
